description: Implementation of AuthenticatorApiService class handling authenticator-related API calls, including listing, deleting, generating registration/authentication options, and verifying registration responses.

classes.name: AuthenticatorApiService
classes.description: Service class implementing authenticator API operations, managing in-progress states, and handling server communication.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Fetches list of authenticators, throws error if operation is already in progress.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an authenticator by ID, with concurrency check.

methods.name: generateRegistrationOptions
methods.description: Generates registration options for authenticators, with concurrency control.

methods.name: verifyRegistrationResponse
methods.description: Verifies registration response with provided user info and attestation data.

methods.name: generateAuthenticationOptions
methods.description: Generates authentication options for a user, with concurrency check.
